**What needs to be fixed:**
- PR description is missing required template sections. Please use the [PR template](../blob/dev/.github/pull_request_template.md).

Please edit this PR description to address the above within **2 hours**, or it will be automatically closed.

If you believe this was flagged incorrectly, please let a maintainer know.

_The following comment was made by an LLM, it may be inaccurate:_

**Potential duplicate found:**

- **PR #12721**: "feat(tui): add tokens per second to response footer"
  - https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/12721
  - This appears to be the exact same feature—adding tokens per second display to the TUI message footer. Both PRs aim to show tokens per second (t/s) metrics alongside model and duration information.

You should check if PR #12721 is already merged, closed, or still open before proceeding with PR #33538.
@rekram1-node this is a bug report and there is a fix for it.

This is a feature request, not a question :) 

The feature request is to update the question ui/ux
